title: Playboy September 1975 Erica Jong Interview Tim Leary Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Vintage 1975 issue. Covers bright with light toning; a small blue pen mark near the left edge of the front cover, light spine and edge wear, and a small corner nick on the back cover. No tears. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, September 1975 issue, original $1.25 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover features: Exclusive - how Tim Leary turned informer; James Jones on the last good war; College Is a Bummer!; Football's Bottom Line (the pigskin preview); Erica Jong interview - beyond "Fear of Flying".

Back cover: Marlboro Lights ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
